body:
Founder real-time: 'lets not work on voxworld this is a legacy world ... we need a way to string 2 levels together ... we need the loading points or whatever the opposite of the spawners is.' New LevelExit scriptable object (placed trigger volume), NextLevelID (nullable, v0 chain, DB-validated must-reference-real-level + self-reference rejection), IsStoryStart (mirrors IsDefaultQueue's exactly-one shape, new SetStoryStartLevel + PATCH .../story-start endpoint). Threaded through the full CRUD/Export pattern. New 'Level exits'/'Next level'/'Set as STORY start' NOCK UI. 9 new tests, full suite green. Deployed + live-verified: migration applied to the live DB, iduna.service restarted, a real test level inserted+flagged+deleted confirmed the public registry endpoint reflects is_story_start correctly. Commits: 5f54191, af4edac, a9a4997.

⚓ ☃
title: S473 Phase 1: real level graph (next_level_id/is_story_start/LevelExit) + NOCK UI
